sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Diwan Saifullah Khan Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and perused the record.
By moving this application learned counsel for the applicants has prayed to quash the summoning order dated 03.09.2022 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 1, Rampur as well as the entire proceeding of F.R. Case No. 109/12/2022 (Smt. Naseem Jahjan Vs. Raja Ali &
others) under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, arising out of Case Crime No. 556 of 2021, Police Station Swar, District Rampur.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that the sister of the victim was enticed away by the husband of the victim and they are said to be living together.

sentences.text: After performing the second marriage, the husband of the victim is said to have given her divorce.
Because of this reason only, this FIR, Case Crime No. 556 of 2021 had been lodged with the false allegations.

In the FIR,
there was no specific allegation against the applicants.
Only general allegation was made against all the members of the matrimonial family of the victim.

The applicants are the brother-in-laws (Jeth)
of the victim.
They have no concern with the victim or her husband or with the demand of dowry.

sentences.text: They are living separately.
The victim is living in her parental house since 01.09.2021.
No injury is found on the person of the victim, hence, prayer is made accordingly.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2, however, opposed the prayer and submitted that the applicants have been summoned on the basis of evidence recorded by the Investigating Officer after lodging the impugned FIR wherein there are specific allegations against the applicants.
In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also the victim has supported the allegations of the FIR.

Hence,
the impugned order is lawful order passed on merit after recording the satisfaction of the court.
Therefore, prayer is made to reject the application.

It is admitted fact that on 31.08.2021 the husband of the victim enticed away the younger major sister of the victim along with him and next day i.e. on 01.09.2021 they are said to have solemnised 'nikah' and it is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that since 01.09.2021 only the alleged victim is living in her parental house.
So, no cause of action regarding any incident after 01.09.2021 arises.
Thus, admittedly since the husband of the victim performed his second marriage the victim is said to be living in her parental house, she was given triple talak by her husband.
The reason of living in the parental house is clarified by the victim that she was being harassed for extra dowry by all the accused persons.
The names of the present accused persons are specifically mentioned alleging the demand of extra dowry.
Again, there is allegation of committing forceful abortion regarding pregnancy of the victim.
This allegation is also raised against all the applicants.

In her statement under Sections 161 and 164 CR.P.C. also the victim has reiterated the facts mentioned in the FIR, though, final report is said to have been filed after investigation in the matter but after filing the protest petition by the victim the Magistrate rejected the final report and summoned all the accused persons on the basis of evidence collected by the Investigating Officer before filing the final report.

In her statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. the victim is said to have supported the version of the FIR wherein specific allegation of harassment regarding demand of dowry is said to have been made by the victim.

In the opinion of the court, the impugned order, which has been passed on the basis of the evidence collected by the Investigating Officer before filing of final report, cannot be said to be erroneous.
There is no illegality in the order impugned.
The arguments of the learned counsel for the applicants have no force.
The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, thus, rejected.
However, the applicants are free to move discharge application before the trial court.
